author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The United States overcame a 14-point deficit to beat France 97-79 in the Women’s World Cup final Sunday, Reuters reported. The victory gave the Americans their fifth consecutive title and extended a 20-year unbeaten run across the Olympics and World Cup.

Breanna Stewart led the United States with 22 points as the team recovered from a difficult start. France reached the final for the first time and finished with its best result in the tournament, but the Americans’ second-half response turned a close contest into a clear win.

The result continues the United States’ long dominance of international women’s basketball while giving France a landmark finish to build on. The final also underscored the value of composure after the Americans fell behind by 14 before taking control.
France’s first final appearance nevertheless gave the tournament a new competitive storyline, while the United States added another title to a run that has defined the event for a generation.
dek: The United States rallied from a 14-point deficit to beat France 97-79 in the final and win a fifth straight Women’s World Cup.
headline: USA overcome 14-point deficit, beat France 97-79 to win Women’s World Cup
